description: Defines the GatekeeperStorage abstract class for managing secure data storage, including methods for allocation, key checking, reading, and writing binary blobs, with specific emphasis on secure handling within the Android Open Source Project.

classes.name: GatekeeperStorage
classes.description: An abstract class providing an interface for secure storage operations such as allocating space, checking key existence, reading, and writing data blobs, tailored for Android's gatekeeper security module.

methods.name: ~GatekeeperStorage
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the GatekeeperStorage class.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates storage for a given key with specified size.

methods.name: HasKey
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in storage.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Retrieves data associated with a given key as a TPM2B_MAX_NV_BUFFER.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Stores data associated with a given key into secure storage.
